notes.content:
Changes:

- Add Korean localisation

notes.title: 1.0.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

- Fix bugs when exiting [spoiler]memory injector[/spoiler] in certain scenarios

notes.title: 1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Changes:

- Add exiting from [spoiler]MEMORY_INJECTION returns the player to BACKEND[/spoiler]

Bug Fixes:

- Fix folders app not reseting when using [spoiler]MEMORY_INJECTION[/spoiler]
- Fix [spoiler]MEMORY_INJECTION[/spoiler] transition effects 
- Fix coffee machine sfx keeps playing after skip cutscene
- Fix speed variables not changing if blockColor set to non-colour variable (Stac) [4E02-2]
- *Fix crowd subtitle not clearing on occasion [5E02-5]
- Fix minor grammar mistakes and subtitle typesetting

notes.title: 1.0.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

- Fix soft lock introduced in 1.0.4 if you exit the game during 5E02-4

notes.title: 1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Changes:

- Setup Fireworks4 by default [5E02]
- Swap Duck Game shoot buttons on gamepads to match controller scheme [5E02]

Bug Fixes:

- *Fix some players starting upstairs instead of the staircase [6E01]
- Fix bug allowing player to press the detonator if setup, but without the fireworks setup [5E02-3]
- Fix ‘Detonator’ spelled as ‘Detanator’ on one label [5E02-3]

notes.title: 1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Changes:

- Add Moonie npc [2E02-4]

Bug Fixes:

- Fix playtime over 24hrs showing as 0 in Game Data menu
- Disable Fireworks4 after completing the corresponding task [5E02-3]
- Fix player getting stuck outside elevator under certain conditions [6E02]

notes.title: 1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Changes:

- Add setting to turn of controller notifications (Controls menu)

Bug Fixes:

- Fix player stats not saving when using memory injector
- Prevent multiple fast travel profiles being able to be triggered instantaneously

notes.title: One Dreamer: Demo Infinite Runner Competition
notes.content:
Win a copy of One Dreamer + your name/alias in the game!

Finish in the top 3 of the NXT arcade game’s leaderboard to win!

To enter download One Dreamer’s limited time demo and go to the arcade area where the new NXT infinite runner mini-game is located.

This competition will only be available during the Steam Next Fest (June 13-20, 2022) and the final leaderboard results will be locked in once the event has finished.

Notes: 
- A tied score for any of the top 3 ranks will result in both/all players winning. 
- Winners will be contacted via Steam Chat.
- The NXT mini-game is only available in One Dreamer: Demo (June 13-20, 2022).
